title: Research: Claim-Aware Authorization to Verdict-Gated Escrow (Experimental)
body:
This experimental adapter tests whether the independently recomputed claim-aware result from #7 can authorize the existing verdict-gated escrow without changing either implementation. It binds a scoped claim to a canonical payment request, separate payer grant, trusted escrow snapshot and the escrow's actual BIP-340 signing format, then exercises the unchanged Solidity contract in a local EVM.

**PARTIALLY_COMPATIBLE · LABORATORY_VERIFIED · PARTIAL_CHAIN_VERIFIED. HOLD for production payments.** This is bounded research for independent review, not a production payment system, full external evidence chain or security certification. Keep this PR Draft and unmerged.

## Inventory repair and current CI

Current HEAD: `de3826fd777ab391a99237114b9e5947b7d8b4c9`. Base #7 remains `c93087f06bd14c45a1d12b0c068195e3bef05dae` on `research/claim-aware-composition-integration`.

The original published `ac30419dd5a2e72fe9e359bbbb538f58fc5f40c0` remains historical evidence. Its 16 inherited workflow runs failed because the whole-repository inventory omitted exactly 1,154 experimental additions. Fresh replay reproduced each failing entrypoint, with zero changed original hashes, zero missing originals and zero unintended generated files. Those failed runs have not been relabeled or overwritten.

The repair uses the existing canonical `tools/verify_artifacts.py --write` procedure after independent Git-tree reconciliation. The verifier itself and all inherited workflows remain unchanged. The current root inventory covers **11,870 files** and retains all **10,708 original entries and digests**. The separate experiment inventory covers **1,161 files**. Both original manifests are archived byte-for-byte. Only three existing experimental/index files intentionally change: the two current manifests and the experimental baseline checker. Eight files are added, principally CI, its controls, repair documentation and preserved manifests.

The first repair commit `0f65b7e7fb20684cea60d5dd7a246dcea20663c0` passed all 16 inherited workflows, but both new escrow jobs correctly refused LF forge-std checkout bytes: the frozen 72-file runtime lock records the initial Windows CRLF representation. The follow-up explicitly reproduces those exact locked bytes using Git checkout conversion under ignored `build/`, then runs the unchanged hash checker. A fresh public clone matches all 72 original pins and the locally tested dependency bytes. No pin, upstream Git blob or repository text file is normalized or rewritten. Failed runs 39528141833 and 39528146675 and the complete read-only byte diagnosis remain preserved.

The baseline checker permits only the root index refresh: unchanged schema/exclusions, every old entry unchanged, canonical bytes and a successful complete current inventory check. Every other #7 blob remains byte-identical. A changed-and-rehashed old proof is explicitly rejected by an independent negative control. No general baseline exclusion or CI bypass was added.

**CI_GREEN: 18 exact-head workflow runs / 20 jobs passed**, including push and pull-request executions. [Dedicated escrow replay](https://github.com/pipavlo82/verifiable-ai-guarantee-composition/actions/runs/39530793972). Downloaded raw evidence confirms 31/31 outcomes, the mutation results below, five CI negative controls and semantic equality between local Windows and fresh Linux runs. Native source is freshly built and tested in CI; local replay reused the previously verified pinned binary and actually reexecuted proof verification.

Five CI failure controls demonstrate rejection of a changed pinned proof, missing expected file, unlisted file, changed-and-rehashed original proof, and an actual surviving authorization mutation in a disposable copy. The last intentionally constructs **16 KILLED / 1 SURVIVED / 0 CRASHED** and requires both the mutation harness and strict CI gate to fail. It is a CI negative control, not a stock survivor or an extra kill. Positive and restored controls pass.

## Preserved sources

- Escrow: `babyblueviper1/invinoveritas@ce8c504f2ae4d9b389b53823fe16afec7fcf3bb3`.
- zkIE: `trustless-ai/zkIE@39d8df96877bc3bebf33c69b06907d792b3184b9`.
- ERC-8404 PR #1980 draft: `pipavlo82/ERCs@7a9e63a80bce04db53c6550103c1d41eca35f3d1`.
- forge-std: `b013eff2ac4fce26f34d789e6f5c49021c5ee817` (72-file lock).

All 10,708 non-index #7 blobs, ten vendored escrow files and thirteen frozen ERC-8404 Core files remain byte-identical. The #7 branch, upstream escrow and ERC Core are not modified. Historical captures and reports are retained as observations at their original commits.

## Executed results

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Scenario outcomes, normal / repeated / Python `-O` | **31/31 expected** per mode |
| Original escrow tests | 7/7 |
| Adapter Python tests | 9/9 per mode |
| Semantic-determinism harness tests | 4/4 per mode |
| New Foundry test methods | 7/7 per mode |
| Python / Node ABI-digest and Schnorr checks | 33/33 per mode |
| New adapter mutations | 17 KILLED per mode |
| New Solidity source-copy mutations | 5 KILLED |
| New applied mutations combined | **22 KILLED / 0 SURVIVED / 0 CRASHED** |
| Absent upstream on-chain checks | **6 NOT_APPLIED**, separate from applied mutations |
| Unchanged #7 regression | 16 tests and 22 historical mutation controls |

Each kill requires a distinguishing negative witness, positive control and restored baseline. Crashes do not count as kills. Six absent checks are document-recipient binding, document-amount binding, global nonce consumption, expiration, signer revocation and claim-scope interpretation. These guards are not implemented in the unchanged escrow and are not falsely credited as covered mutations.

## Finite comparison and actual local execution

The shared authorization domain contains one positive and 28 negative cases. Two execution-only token controls bring the total to 31.

| Configuration | Unsupported authorizations | Correct refusals | UNVERIFIABLE |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| A: trusted signed verdict only | **24/28** | 4/28 | 0 |
| B: claim-aware verification + verdict at issuance | **2/28** | 26/28 | 2 |
| C: B + unchanged on-chain enforcement | **2/28** | 26/28 | 2 |

All accept the positive. Residual B/C cases are reuse after expiration or a laboratory signer-revocation policy change **after signing**. They do not show incorrect original admission and are not surviving mutants. No fresh off-chain execution-time reauthorization is claimed.

The positive executes a **local mock-token release**, increasing the recipient balance by 1,000,000 base units. Historical reference warm-call gas is 36,654; it excludes intrinsic/calldata costs, Base L1 fees and cold-state differences. Current raw measurements remain separate from semantic determinism because harness path allocation affects measured gas. No real funds or network transactions are used. The original strict gas-equality failure and its correction remain preserved.

## Observed behavior versus documented guarantees

The unchanged escrow enforces its fixed signer, actual chain/contract/payment identity, approving signature, funded state and stored payment terms. Same-escrow replay, duplicate release and release after refund are rejected. Editing signed request metadata does not change already funded recipient/amount storage.

The additional research policy checks correspondence between the request's semantic terms and stored payment terms. The escrow commits to request hashes without interpreting their preimages; missing semantic enforcement is an unsupported additional downstream guarantee, not a violation of the contract's documented stored-term guarantee. `refundAfter` enables refund rather than imposing release expiration. The signer is immutable with no revocation/rotation API; submission IDs are not globally consumed across distinct payments.

A valid signature by the fixed key can reach the contract without proving this off-chain gate ran. Authenticity does not establish verdict truth; different keys do not establish different real-world controllers. Successful token calls do not establish external work completion. The lying-token control is not an allegation against USDC.

Preserved read-only Base observations agree across two RPCs and match the compiled original-source runtime with immutable substitutions. This establishes bytecode/RPC consistency, not independent consensus or actual task/payment execution. The private production relay is unavailable; its ledger/signing-policy compatibility remains unverified.

## Reproduction and archive integrity

Use Python 3.12, Node 22.15.0, Bun 1.3.14, Rust/Cargo 1.97.1, Foundry 1.7.1 (`4072e48705af9d93e3c0f6e29e93b5e9a40caed8`) and solc 0.8.26. Actions and dependency sources are pinned in the workflow/locks. No deployment or broadcast is required.

```sh
git clone --config core.autocrlf=false --branch experiment/claim-aware-verdict-escrow-v0 --single-branch https://github.com/pipavlo82/verifiable-ai-guarantee-composition.git escrow-replay
cd escrow-replay
git checkout --detach de3826fd777ab391a99237114b9e5947b7d8b4c9
python -B -X utf8 tools/verify_artifacts.py
python -B -X utf8 tools/v3/prepare.py --online
git -c core.autocrlf=true clone --no-checkout https://github.com/foundry-rs/forge-std.git build/escrow/forge-std-source
git -C build/escrow/forge-std-source -c core.autocrlf=true checkout --detach b013eff2ac4fce26f34d789e6f5c49021c5ee817
python -B -X utf8 tools/escrow_prepare.py --forge-std-cache build/escrow/forge-std-source
python -B -X utf8 tools/escrow_ci.py
python -B -X utf8 tools/verify_artifacts.py
python -B -X utf8 tools/escrow_bytecode.py evidence/escrow-v0/public evidence/escrow-v0/compiler/VerdictGatedEscrow.json
git status --porcelain=v1
git archive --format=zip --output=../claim-aware-verdict-escrow-ci-de3826fd.zip de3826fd777ab391a99237114b9e5947b7d8b4c9
```

Set `FORGE` if executable discovery requires it. CI never regenerates the inventory. Offline preparation options remain in `research/escrow-v0/REPRODUCTION.md`; repair details are in `research/escrow-v0/CI_INVENTORY_REPAIR.md`. Deterministic public laboratory keys are used.

Fresh public checkout and all **11871 Git blobs / ZIP members** were independently reconciled. Current source/evidence archive SHA-256:

```text
a3344052309acdc5433ed217bc8260c6045ded0545c9226ba998e413e5c02842
```

Archive made with Git 2.54.0.windows.1; compressed bytes can depend on the Git/compression implementation, so also verify exact blob contents. The old `ac30419d` ZIP remains `e324a770448a9302ec4bde75d63bb30b1ecd689bcb7e26b5c3465276b1a1fdbe`; its bundle remains `5bb0f179408fa083f39beb6cb5efda17a63c3d4cb087c14f095742bee9ac0101`. These historical identifiers are not relabeled as the repair archive. Local archives are not implied to be GitHub release assets.

## Independent review checklist and remaining blockers

- [ ] Verify exact HEAD, #7 ancestry, narrow repair diff, both inventories and frozen source hashes.
- [ ] Independently replay the proof, EIP-712, ERC-8404 consumer, Python/Node/Solidity signatures and all 31 scenarios.
- [ ] Recompute contract/request/profile/evidence preimages and payer-grant bindings rather than trusting a mutable flag.
- [ ] Reproduce 17 adapter + 5 Solidity kills, five CI failure controls and six absent checks as NOT_APPLIED.
- [ ] Audit the manifest-refresh exception, including changed-and-rehashed original rejection.
- [ ] Review lifecycle expiry/revocation, nonce scope, fixed-key bypass and stored-versus-document terms.
- [ ] Establish private relay compatibility, trusted payer/state acquisition, signer policy and complete external execution evidence before broader integration.

Input admission, deployed-model authorization, judgment truth, independent external execution and full payment-chain evidence remain missing or assumed. Contract adequacy and trusted policy selection remain external assumptions. **CI_GREEN does not remove HOLD for production payments. No FULL_CHAIN_VERIFIED or production-readiness claim.** No merge, upstream change, deployment or funds transfer.
